sources.title: MediaStream Recording
sources.locator: §2.1 constructor step 4; §2.3 start, stop, pause/resume, inactivate, isTypeSupported; §6.1
sources.judgment: Lifecycle/chunk/default distinctions supported; important probe exception missing from authored maps.
sources.governing_conditions: Public probe passes false, constructor passes true to deferred-codec check. Only enumerated codec identifiers are synchronously exposed; newer identifiers can give a negative probe without the same constructor rejection. Empty MIME leaves UA choice. Normal stop yields final data before stop; completed concatenation rather than every chunk is the playable object. Resource exhaustion remains possible.

sources.judgment: PCM-processing/encoding distinction, quantum and sample-rate qualifications supported.
sources.governing_conditions: Default render quantum is 128 frames; renderSizeHint may request another size and may not be honored. Worklet processing has a rendering deadline. A stream source resamples to context rate; that processing rate is not proof of physical hardware rate. File encoding/header/muxing are separate responsibilities.

critiques.assessment: Safari 26 was incorrectly called current. Official Safari 27 release predates the research date. Final corrects the release lane while treating 26 as history and silence about formats as non-evidence.

critiques.independent_judgment: SUPPORTED need for explicit acceptance boundary
critiques.assessment: The draft left the five-minute interpretation/over-limit outcome open. Final supplies strict encoded-duration recommendation, reliable verification requirement and fail-closed outcome. Owner acceptance and implementation remain openly external; this is a plan, not a completed deployment.

Critic says Safari 18.4 announced Ogg recording. Governing release pages announce generic Ogg media support separately from explicit WebM MediaRecorder support; pinned Cocoa recorder source also lacks Ogg. Final does not repeat Ogg-recording success: strings are exploratory and require all gates. The false criticism was not expressly rejected. Two extra exploratory probes do not impose a recording capability or remove a requested feature.
Safari 14.1 API history is true; original discovery/draft lacked the corresponding source ID. Final adds C02 and keeps it historical.

Original S11 omitted maintainer/reporter follow-up and closure. Final captures destination-stream/two-channel diagnosis, advice, closure and separate later report without claiming a general fix. The later reporter declined the adapted suggestion, not all possible fixes.

independence: Retrieved governing primary evidence independently; original source maps supply locators, not semantic proof. No candidate assistance or comparator outcome reviewed.
